Early helpers matched duplicate progress labels, an incorrect invitations/relations/restore endpoint or a desktop-only status button on mobile. Corrected control targeting and fresh persisted reads supplied the subsequent evidence.

limitations: Review and execution were performed by agents. No human usability or accessibility-assistive-technology session is claimed.

privacy: Email links, passwords, tokens, auth state, provider keys and raw configuration remain outside the repository.
